title: 第851章 占山为王第850章 闭关炼丹
content_zh:
收起丹炉，江凡长长吐出一口浊气，那气息如青烟盘旋，在空中凝而不散，竟隐隐化作一缕雷纹，方才缓缓消散。
半年光阴，弹指即逝。他几乎未曾踏出丹房半步，日夜与炉火为伴，与灵草对话，与丹道争锋。
可即便如此，那一万六千余株灵草，也仅消耗了三分之一，余下的，仍静静躺在储物戒中，灵气未散，药性未衰。
修为上，他从筑基七重初期，稳稳踏入筑基七重中期。看似寸进，实则根基已深如渊海，每一缕灵力都经雷火淬炼，每一道经脉皆被丹气洗伐，肉身之强，堪比金丹体修。
然而，金丹境界……依旧遥不可及。
“万里之遥，非一日可越。”他低声自语，眼中无焦躁，只有沉静，“此界天道有缺，筑基到金丹，需引天地共鸣，可如今灵气驳杂，道韵残缺，两三年能破境，已是天眷。”
他推开丹房石门，寒风裹着雪粒扑面而来，却在触及他衣袍时悄然化雾。院中，莫轻舞正坐在青玉小案旁，素手执壶，慢条斯理地沏着一壶“雪心茶”。她周身再无寒冰外溢的躁意，只余温润内敛的金丹气息，筑基巅峰至金丹，半年破境，已算神速。
在这修真界，金丹修士便可开山立派，受一方敬仰。她终于……有了真正立足的资本。
见他出来，莫轻舞抬眸一笑，眼底星光点点：“出关啦？我还以为你要炼到地老天荒。”
江凡走到她对面坐下，接过她递来的茶盏，“若非天元草没了，我还能再炼三月”，他淡淡道，语气却带着一丝连自己都未察觉的疲惫。
莫轻舞看着他眉间那道更深的雷痕，心头微疼，却只柔声道：“你为苍玄宗炼了近两千枚丹，够用了。接下来……该为自己想想了。”
江凡只是低头喝茶，他知道她说的是什么，修为停滞，瓶颈将至，若再不寻突破之法，恐将困于筑基，终其一生难窥金丹门径。
“婉瑶与靖雯突破至筑基九重，紫菱与子茜突破至筑基八重，”莫轻舞一边给江凡斟茶，一边轻声说道，语气里带着欣慰，也有一丝不易察觉的凝重，“估计两三年内，她们都能跻身金丹行列。”
她顿了顿，指尖轻轻摩挲杯沿，声音低了几分：“可你也知道……境界越高，突破越难。筑基初期到中期，靠苦修便能水到渠成；可筑基巅峰到金丹，不是光靠灵气就能跨过去的坎。”
“有些散修，资质不差，苦修百年，灵力早已圆满，却因无上品功法、无护道之人、无天材地宝辅助，生生困在筑基巅峰，直至寿元枯竭……一步之遥，却是生死之隔。”
江凡沉默片刻，将茶一饮而尽。他当然明白，此方修真界，资源垄断于大宗门之手，散修如浮萍，纵有天赋，也常因一枚筑基丹、一道金丹引气诀而蹉跎一生。
而婉瑶她们能半年连破数重，靠的不只是自身努力，更是他炼出的丹药、布下的聚灵阵、亲自校正的功法，以及……一个不再让她们孤军奋战的宗门。
江凡缓缓起身，望向远处山峦：“我要建丹阁、立藏经楼、开演武台、设护宗大阵……让每一个入门弟子，都有路可走，有丹可用，有阵可依。我不求她们人人成元婴，但至少，别再有人，因缺一枚丹，困死在筑基巅峰。”
莫轻舞望着他，忽然笑了，眼中却泛起微光：“那这第一座丹阁，可得建在主峰旁边，不然你炼丹时，怎么监督你偷懒？”
江凡也笑了，伸手揉了揉她的发顶：“好，建在你洞府门口。你若闭关，我就在楼下炼丹，你安心修你的道，我守我的炉，也守你。”

“好啊，那我就当你的炼丹童子，”莫轻舞眼波流转，笑意盈盈，故意板起脸，一本正经道，“宗门俸禄可不能少。”
江凡看着她故作严肃的模样，忍不住低笑出声，青衣微动，眼中雷光也柔和了几分：“俸禄自然不少，每月十枚上品灵石，三瓶回元丹，外加……一件新衣。”
莫轻舞佯怒：“就这点？我可是金丹真人！还是苍玄宗圣女！”
“哦？”江凡挑眉，眼中闪过促狭，“那圣女大人想要多少？”
莫轻舞凑近一步，压低声音，带着几分狡黠：“每月一百枚上品灵石，十瓶绝品丹，霓裳居新款衣服不限量供应。”
江凡沉默片刻，忽然握住她的手，声音低而郑重：“好，都依你，但有个条件。”
莫轻舞眨眨眼，笑意未散：“什么条件？”
江凡却没再提丹阁、俸禄，也没说炼丹守约，而是轻轻一拉她的手，望向远方云海翻涌的北荒天际：“大家闭关也有半年多了，武华山的风波已过去，咱们去玄冰宗旧址逛逛，顺便布下封山大阵。”
莫轻舞微微一怔，玄冰宗……那个她曾视为家的地方，如今早已人去楼空，冰宫封印，灵泉枯寂。自凤姥叛陨落、江凡下令解散宗门后，那里便成了一座被遗忘的废墟。
“好。”她轻声应下，反手回握他的手，指尖微暖，“不过……你得答应我，别在祖师殿前站太久。那儿冷，我怕你又想起那些糟心事。”

刚从闭关密室走出的季浮生、顾长生、秦世云三人，恰好听见江凡那句“去玄冰宗旧址布下封山大阵”，顿时眼前一亮，“来到中域近六年了，我们还不知道玄冰宗长什么样呢！”
莫轻舞见他们兴致勃勃，不禁莞尔，眼中泛起温柔笑意，抬手指向山门之外：“玄冰宗山门外有个非常大的天池，景色非常优美。”
秦世云哈哈一笑：“那还等什么？布阵之前，先去天池边扎营！我带了灵茶和烤架，今日不谈宗门旧事，只赏山水，吃鱼喝酒！”
没有停留，五人御剑腾空，遁光如虹，划破烬雪谷上空的薄云。半年闭关，山川未改，人心已新，昔日从地球而来的凡人少年少女，如今御风踏云，谈笑间直指北荒旧宗废墟。
不到两个时辰，五道遁光便已掠过北荒雪原，稳稳落在玄冰宗山门前。然而，眼前景象却令众人眉头齐皱，没有想象中人去楼空的寂寥，反而喧嚣嘈杂，乌烟瘴气！
昔日清冷肃穆的玄冰宗山门，如今竟被数十名散修占据。有人在祖师殿前支起大锅炖肉，油污溅满“玄冰圣境”牌坊；更有几人围着天池边缘，用火符炙烤池水，试图逼出寒髓玉鳞鱼，池面灵雾被熏得浑浊不堪。
秦世云冷笑一声，袖中雷符隐现：“半年前江凡一纸令下解散玄冰宗，是给同门留体面；可这群蝼蚁，竟敢趁虚而入，占山为王？”
见金丹大能降临玄冰宗，那群散修顿时魂飞魄散，他们原以为玄冰宗已彻底覆灭，山门无主，才敢结伙占山、搜刮残宝。可谁料，江凡竟亲自回来了，更可怕的是，他身边那位白衣女子，周身金丹气息如渊似海，分明已是真正的金丹真人！
数十名散修如惊弓之鸟，转身就逃，连锅灶都顾不上收。然而，江凡袖袍一振，青雷如网，瞬间封锁整座山门。“想走？不把山门打扫干净，你们一个也别想离开。”

content_en:
Putting away the alchemy furnace, Jiang Fan let out a long breath of turbid air. The breath hovered like green smoke, condensing in the air without dissipating, and turned into a faint streak of thunder before slowly dissipating.
Half a year passed in a blink of an eye. He has barely stepped out of the alchemy room. He stays with the fire day and night, talks with spiritual herbs, and competes with the alchemy way.
But even so, only one-third of the more than 16,000 spiritual herbs were consumed, and the rest were still lying quietly in the storage ring, with their spiritual energy not dissipated and their medicinal properties not diminished.
In terms of cultivation, he has steadily entered the middle stage of the seventh level of foundation building from the early stage of the seventh level of foundation building. It seems like an inch of progress, but in fact the foundation is as deep as the abyss. Every ray of spiritual power has been tempered by thunder and fire, and every meridian has been washed by elixir energy. The physical body is as strong as the golden elixir body cultivation.
However, the Golden Core realm... is still out of reach.
"A distance of thousands of miles cannot be crossed in a day." He whispered to himself, there was no anxiety in his eyes, only calmness, "There is a lack of heavenly Dao in this world. To build the foundation to the golden elixir, it needs to resonate with the heaven and earth. But now the spiritual energy is mixed and the Dao rhyme is incomplete. If you can break through the realm in two or three years, you are already a blessing from heaven."
He pushed open the stone door of the alchemy room, and the cold wind blew into his face wrapped in snow particles, but it quietly turned into mist when it touched his robe. In the courtyard, Mo Qingwu was sitting next to the small sapphire table, holding a pot in her bare hands, slowly brewing a pot of "Snow Heart Tea". There is no restlessness overflowing from the ice around her, only the warm and restrained aura of the golden elixir remains. The peak of foundation building to the golden elixir, breaking through in half a year, is already considered an amazing speed.
In this world of cultivation, Jindan monks can establish a sect and be respected by everyone. She finally...had the capital to truly stand on her own feet.
Seeing him coming out, Mo Qingwu raised her eyes and smiled, her eyes twinkling with stars: "Are you out of seclusion? I thought you were going to practice till the end of the world."
Jiang Fan walked to sit across from her and took the teacup she handed him. "If the Tianyuan Grass hadn't disappeared, I could still practice for three months," he said calmly, but his tone contained a hint of exhaustion that he was not even aware of.
Mo Qingwu looked at the deeper thunder mark between his eyebrows, her heart ached slightly, but she only said softly: "You have refined nearly two thousand pills for Cangxuan Sect, which is enough. Next...it's time to think about yourself."
Jiang Fan just lowered his head to drink tea. He knew what she was talking about. His cultivation was stagnant and a bottleneck was approaching. If he didn't find a way to break through, he might be stuck in building a foundation and would never be able to see the golden elixir for the rest of his life.
"Wanyao and Jingwen have broken through to the ninth level of foundation building, and Ziling and Zi Qian have broken through to the eighth level of foundation building," Mo Qingwu said softly while pouring tea for Jiang Fan, with a hint of relief and a hint of unnoticeable solemnity in her tone, "It is estimated that within two or three years, they will all be able to join the ranks of golden elixirs."
She paused, gently rubbed the edge of the cup with her fingertips, and said in a lower voice: "But you also know... the higher the realm, the harder it is to break through. In the early to mid-stage of foundation building, hard work can be done easily; but from the peak of foundation building to the golden elixir, it is not a hurdle that can be overcome with aura alone."
"Some casual cultivators have good qualifications. They have practiced hard for a hundred years and have already perfected their spiritual power. However, due to the supreme skills, no guardians, and no heavenly and earthly treasures to assist them, they are stuck at the peak of foundation building until their longevity is exhausted... One step away is the difference between life and death."
Jiang Fan was silent for a moment and drank the tea in one gulp. Of course he understands that in this world of cultivation, resources are monopolized by large sects, and casual cultivators are like duckweeds. Even if they have talent, their lives are often wasted because of a Foundation Building Pill or a Golden Pill Qi Entrainment Technique.
Wanyao and the others were able to break through several levels in six months, not only because of their own efforts, but also because of the elixirs he refined, the spirit gathering arrays he set up, the techniques he calibrated himself, and... a sect that no longer allowed them to fight alone.
Jiang Fan stood up slowly and looked at the mountains in the distance: "I want to build an alchemy pavilion, a sutra collection building, a martial arts stage, and a sect-protecting formation...so that every entry-level disciple has a path to follow, elixirs to use, and formations to rely on. I don't ask all of them to become Nascent Souls, but at least, no one will die at the peak of foundation building because of a lack of elixirs."
Mo Qingwu looked at him and suddenly smiled, but there was a glimmer in her eyes: "Then this first Dan Pavilion must be built in the main building."Next to Feng, otherwise, how can I supervise your laziness when you are refining alchemy? "
Jiang Fan also smiled and reached out to rub the top of her hair: "Okay, I'll build it at the entrance of your cave. If you are in seclusion, I will be refining elixirs downstairs. You can practice your way with peace of mind. I will guard my furnace and you. "
"Okay, then I will be your alchemy boy," Mo Qingwu's eyes flashed, her smile was full of smiles, she deliberately kept a straight face, and said seriously, "The sect's salary is indispensable. "
Seeing her pretending to be serious, Jiang Fan couldn't help but chuckle, his green clothes moved slightly, and the lightning in his eyes softened a bit: "The salary is certainly quite generous, ten high-grade spiritual stones per month, three bottles of Yuanhui Dan, plus... a new dress. "
Mo Qingwu feigned anger: "That's it? I am Jin Dan Zhenren! She is still the Saint of Cangxuan Sect! "
"oh? "Jiang Fan raised his eyebrows, a flash of narrowness in his eyes, "How much does the saintly lady want? "
Mo Qingwu took a step closer, lowered her voice, and said with a hint of cunning: "One hundred high-grade spiritual stones, ten bottles of top-grade elixirs, and unlimited supply of new clothes in Nishangju every month. "
Jiang Fan was silent for a moment, then suddenly held her hand and said in a low and solemn voice: "Okay, it's all up to you, but there is a condition. "
Mo Qingwu blinked, her smile still lingering: "What conditions? "
Jiang Fan did not mention the Alchemy Pavilion or salary, nor did he talk about refining alchemy and keeping the promise. Instead, he gently held her hand and looked at the distant sky of Beihuang where the sea of clouds was billowing: "We have been in retreat for more than half a year. The storm in Wuhua Mountain has passed. Let's go to the old site of Xuanbing Sect and set up a mountain sealing formation. "
Mo Qingwu was slightly startled. The Xuan Bing Sect... the place she once regarded as home was now empty of people. The ice palace was sealed and the spiritual spring was dry. Ever since Grandma Feng rebelled and fell and Jiang Fan ordered the dissolution of the sect, it has become a forgotten ruin.
"Okay. " She responded softly and held his hand back, her fingertips slightly warm, "But... you have to promise me not to stand in front of the Patriarch's Hall for too long. It's cold there, and I'm afraid you'll think of those bad things again. "

Ji Fusheng, Gu Changsheng, and Qin Shiyun, who had just walked out of the seclusion room, happened to hear Jiang Fan's words, "Go to the old site of the Xuan Bing Sect and set up a mountain sealing formation," and their eyes suddenly lit up, "We have been in the Central Region for nearly six years, and we still don't know what the Xuan Bing Sect looks like! "
Seeing their high spirits, Mo Qingwu couldn't help but smile, with a gentle smile in her eyes, she raised her hand and pointed outside the mountain gate: "There is a very large Tianchi outside the Xuanbing Sect's mountain gate, and the scenery is very beautiful. "
Qin Shiyun laughed: "Then what are you waiting for? Before setting up the formation, go to camp by Tianchi! I brought spiritual tea and a grill. Today I won’t talk about the old affairs of the sect. I will only enjoy the mountains and rivers, eat fish and drink wine! "
Without stopping, the five of them took to the air with their swords, escaping light like a rainbow, cutting through the thin clouds above the Ash Snow Valley. After half a year of seclusion, the mountains and rivers have not changed, and the people's hearts have changed. The mortal boys and girls who came from the earth in the past are now riding on the wind and clouds, talking and laughing directly at the ruins of the old sect in the Northern Wasteland.
In less than two hours, five rays of escaping light had passed through the snowfields of the Northern Wilderness and landed steadily in front of the Xuanbing Sect Mountain Gate. However, the scene in front of them made everyone frown. Instead of the imagined loneliness of an empty building, it was noisy and smoky!
The once cool and solemn gate of the Xuanbing Sect was now occupied by dozens of casual cultivators. Someone set up a large pot to stew meat in front of the Patriarch's Hall, and the oil splashed all over the "Xuanbing Holy Land" archway; there were even a few people around the edge of Tianchi, using fire talismans to roast the water, trying to force out the cold-marrow jade-scaled fish, and the spiritual mist on the surface of the pool was smoked and turned turbid.
Qin Shiyun sneered, and the thunder talisman loomed in his sleeve: "Jiang Fan issued an order to disband the Xuan Bing Sect half a year ago to save dignity for his fellow sects; but these ants dare to take advantage of the situation and occupy the mountain as king? "
Seeing the powerful golden elixir coming to Xuan Bing Sect, the group of casual cultivators were immediately stunned. They thought that Xuan Bing Sect had been completely destroyed and the mountain gate had no owner, so they dared to gang up to occupy the mountain and search for the remaining treasures. But who would have expected that Jiang Fan would come back in person? What’s even more frightening is that the man next to himThe woman in white clothes has a golden elixir aura around her that is as deep as the sea. She is clearly a real golden elixir master!
Dozens of casual cultivators turned around and fled like frightened birds, not even bothering to put away the cooking pots. However, Jiang Fan fluttered his sleeves and robes, and the green thunder was like a net, instantly blocking the entire mountain gate. "Want to leave? If you don't clean the mountain gate, none of you will be able to leave."
